import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = ['Basic', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD'] if 'Basic' in df['Education'].values else df['Education'].value_counts().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', ax=ax1, palette='Set2', order=education_order)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Education', fontsize=9)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Marital Status Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(marital_counts))
ax3.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Total Spending by Product Category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
total_spending = df[spending_cols].sum()
categories = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
bars = ax4.bar(categories, total_spending.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(categories)))
ax4.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Purchase Channels Comparison
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
bars = ax5.bar(channels, purchase_totals.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#95E1D3'])
ax5.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Channel', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Purchases', fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=9)
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6, label='Age')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Kids and Teens at Home
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
kids_data = df[['Kidhome', 'Teenhome']].sum()
ax7.bar(['Kids at Home', 'Teens at Home'], kids_data.values, color=['#FFB6C1', '#87CEEB'])
ax7.set_title('Total Children at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_acceptance = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaigns = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
ax8.bar(campaigns, campaign_acceptance.values, color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(campaigns)))
ax8.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Counts', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_ylabel('Acceptances', fontsize=9)
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Recency Distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(df['Recency'], bins=20, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_title('Recency Distribution (Days Since Last Purchase)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Days', fontsize=9)
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)
ax9.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
